_readme: Accepted-measurement policies for AnonRouter's own confidential gateway (the
first of the two hops this SDK verifies). The second hop, the upstream model
provider's enclave, is pinned separately in measurements.json.
THIS FILE MUST NEVER BE FETCHED FROM THE GATEWAY IT DESCRIBES. A verifier that
downloads its allowlist from the server it is verifying can always be handed an
allowlist naming that server. It ships inside the published packages instead, and
the CI parity gate proves the JavaScript and Python copies never drift.
status=published  a released plane, resolved by verifyGateway() by default.
status=candidate  a reviewed but pre-release plane whose pins are expected to
move. Requires allowCandidate: true, so a default call can
never quietly pass against a plane that is not released.
Every switch in a policy is REQUIRED. A truncated or hand-edited policy fails to
parse rather than silently disabling a check.

policies.notes: AnonRouter confidential content plane running in an Intel TDX CVM (Large class). Published from the independently retained production release manifest with SHA-256 303e61fb7c89a6b7079c489a58955aa9cc76b1e09e03b777f133cdf525f34c8d, which corresponds to operator policy generation 2026-09-12-content-plane-v1.0.20. That manifest binds reviewed monorepo source commit 4c9b984b981a823c016efbbb7d019817e22beca4, the exact measured app compose 9e369fb632fb3b98c604b0c8457448ce88a29077c1766948b87fb6673db494fb, the digest-pinned public content-plane image sha256:d10f4f129efa395bb724798058e93c51f9eb150a25744abee0cbbbc7622de885 from signed tag content-plane-v1.0.20 at public commit 644f50d48f920f1f7720bd5edde4fb93bb1267bf, and eleven further digest-pinned images. The image has a keyless GitHub Actions signature, SLSA v1 provenance whose subject matches the digest, and an SPDX SBOM. Every pinned identity and platform value was re-observed on 2026-09-12 in two independent fresh nonce-bound quotes, one per origin, and each quote's leaf SPKI was separately observed on the wire for that hostname. Both observations match the independently retained manifest and production measurement policy; no value was accepted merely because the gateway reported it. api.private.anonrouter.ai remains an attested alias; api.anonrouter.ai is the customer default. The release id is not treated as sufficient identity: app id, compose hash and every platform measurement remain independently pinned, and mrConfigId independently re-states the compose hash in a register the guest cannot re-narrate. RTMR0 is the hardware-configuration register; this deployment did not resize and RTMR0 remained unchanged. It was not reproduced offline with dstack-mr, so it rests on agreeing independent quotes and the retained manifest rather than an offline recomputation. Two third-party source-to-digest provenance gaps named in the manifest (caddy-edge-base, node-base-image) remain supply-chain limitations, not attestation bypasses. requireHardwareVerified remains true, so verification fails closed unless a DCAP chain verifier is supplied.
